name: Watari (Japan)
description: A brown field charged at the centre with the Watari town emblem in white: a hexagonal device enclosing a triangle.
history: Municipal flag of Watari, a town in Miyagi Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. Flag and emblem were adopted on 2 October 1971.

features.role: Watari town emblem — a hexagonal device enclosing a triangle
